description: Generates a gate and a trigger a set time after Rack starts or a patch is loaded, for modules that need a kick to begin cycling

params.text: Sets the length of the delay, from 1 second to 30 seconds

outputs.text: Starts at 10V the moment Rack is started or the patch is loaded, and drops to 0V once the delay has run out
Starts at 0V the moment Rack is started or the patch is loaded, and rises to 10V once the delay has run out
A 1ms trigger at the moment the delay runs out

notes: once the delay has run out the outputs stay as they are until the patch is loaded again or Rack is restarted
